In which John shares the good news that by raising nearly $39,000,000, nerdfighteria has helped build, staff, supply, and support a Maternal Center of Excellence and NICU at Koidu Government Hospital in Sierra Leone. Over 3,000 babies have been born at the MCOE just in its first nine months, and over 600 babies have received care at the NICU.
